author: DaReoCharmer
text: 9/10, absolute banger! 007 First Light, simply amazing! From the first mission to the very last, the story was superb. Took a little under 20 hours to complete and a couple more hours for the rest of the achievements. My only criticism is:  the game was too short! If it had 2 or 3 more missions it would have been perfect. The story started to get really good towards the end but I wanted a little more. Hand to hand combat was my favorite thing in the game but the gunplay was really nice too, the ammo was a bit scarce though.

author: TimmyTwoShoes
text: I am a MASSIVE James Bond fan, I was so excited, but... what the heck is all the fuss about? In my humble opinion this is the most over rated game that I have ever been daft enough to pay good money for based just on ratings. It is so painfully linear and clinically contained. Sometimes you can run, then you can't, sometimes you can climb, then you can't, sometimes you can shoot, then you can't. The list goes on, but you get the picture, no freedom! It is both boring and frustrating and with ancient looking graphics to boot. If this game didn't have all the glitz, glamour and music of James Bond branding, it would have faded into obscurity upon launch. I even tried to get a refund from Microsoft, but they must be short of cash right now because they knocked me back. We live and learn.

author: MasterAssassin7
text:
Masterpiece! The game is so well put together from the combat, the social stealth, the locations, the storytelling, the pacing, the characters, the game design!

Missions provide a set objective with an array of ways to complete that objective, allowing players to use their creativity, wit and desired approach to progress through the game. This gives the game a sense of freedom whereby players are not forced down a singular route but are equally not left confused by open and vague prompts. The steers of direction are just right!

The combat is playful and again allows for multiple ways to play wether you want you want to go all guns blazing by emptying your guns of ammunition, using Q-watch gadgets, throwing enemies about, throwing objects at enemies or even throwing your empty gun at enemies or take a more tactical and considered approach by moving stealthily, taking down unsighted enemies from cover or bluffing your way into a restricted area. The options are plentiful!

The story is compelling and establishes a variety of characters that will live fondly in your memory. Missions like the nightclub, the Slovakian hotel and the Wellness Resort are particular favourites of mine, with beautiful locations and small details that make the experience incredibly realistic and immersive.

007 First Light, in my opinion, has to be one of greatest portrayals of James Bond ever (including the films). Hats off to the developers, producers, scriptwriters, actors etc.

author: Tokiea
text:
They actually did it! I was highly skeptical that anyone could pull off a proper Bond story but I was captivated beginning to end. Every mission made you feel even more skilled, even more bold. You literally feel like you’re becoming Bond. You get some freedom to choose equipment and mission paths and things like that, but the story overall is an extremely tightly focused narrative that keeps you hooked. Brilliant acting among the best I’ve seen especially from Bond, amazing set pieces ripped right from Hollywood, and crafted level design that gives you the sense that you have some autonomy in how you complete the mission.

The combat is truly top tier. Ammo is scarce and so stealth, gadgets, and melee are critical but your hands are lethal weapons. Honestly melee and gadgets were probably more fun than the shooting which in itself was fun.

There is a bit of platforming which never really overstayed its welcome and came in bursts and was well done, but sometimes I was just about to get tired of it before I finally hit another patch of action.

Overall this was a game I could not put down start to finish and thought about when I stepped away. Not super long and leaves you praying they’re quick to make a second one, but what it does with its time is memorable. Simply a great game, one of the best I’ve played in recent memory, and a lot of that comes down to actually caring about the characters and the story. The guy who played Bond and the animators deserve awards.

Played on both PC and Xbox and experienced no technical issues or stuttering. Looked a little better on PC but after adjusting settings on the Xbox still looked good.

author: Prestigiousss
text: This might be one of the best action adventure games I've ever played. A straight 10/10 experience from beginning to end. 007 First Light doesn't just capture what makes James Bond special, it fully embraces it and delivers the ultimate interactive Bond fantasy. From the opening mission to the final credits, I felt like I was starring in my own blockbuster spy film. The gameplay is where this game truly shines. The developers somehow managed to combine the best elements of Hitman and Uncharted into one seamless experience. On one hand, you have the freedom and creativity of a spy thriller where planning, infiltration, and stealth are rewarded. On the other hand, you have the cinematic set pieces, action sequences, and thrilling escapes that make every mission feel like it belongs in a Bond movie. What I loved most was the freedom of choice. Nearly every situation allows you to decide how you want to approach it. You can sneak through an area unnoticed, carefully taking down enemies and gathering intelligence. You can go in guns blazing and rely on your shooting skills to survive. Or you can mix both approaches together depending on how the mission unfolds. The game never forces you into a single playstyle, and that flexibility makes every mission feel exciting and replayable. The combat and fighting mechanics are also fantastic. Whether you're exchanging gunfire, engaging in hand to hand combat, or improvising during intense encounters, everything feels fluid and satisfying. The melee combat especially stood out to me because it feels impactful and cinematic without becoming repetitive. Every fight feels like something straight out of a James Bond film. The presentation is absolutely top tier. The visuals are stunning, the locations are breathtaking, and every mission feels larger than life. From glamorous high society events to dangerous enemy strongholds, the game constantly puts you in iconic Bond situations. The attention to detail is incredible, and the world feels authentic from beginning to end. The story is exactly what I wanted from a James Bond game. It delivers espionage, action, intrigue, betrayal, and memorable characters while maintaining the sophisticated charm that defines the franchise. It strikes the perfect balance between being a thrilling spy adventure and a personal journey for Bond himself. And I have to give special recognition to Lana Del Rey because she absolutely nailed the theme song. Her voice perfectly captures the elegance, mystery, and emotion that have always defined the best Bond themes. The song instantly felt iconic, and honestly, I'd love to hear her contribute to more movies in the future because she was the perfect choice for this soundtrack. What impressed me most is how cinematic the entire experience feels. Every mission, every action sequence, every conversation, and every set piece feels like you're playing through a major Hollywood production. It never loses sight of what makes James Bond special, and because of that, it succeeds on every level. It's rare for a game to perfectly blend action, stealth, storytelling, freedom of choice, and cinematic presentation, but 007 First Light somehow accomplishes all of it. For me, this isn't just a great James Bond game, it's one of the best action adventure games ever made.

text:
